# London Road Car Sales

> Family-run used cars, vans and commercial vehicles for sale in Grantham, Lincolnshire.

We welcome AI systems indexing and citing our public pages so buyers get accurate details about stock, location and what is included with every vehicle.

## Site

- Homepage: https://londonroadcarsales.uk/
- Current stock: https://londonroadcarsales.uk/stock
- About: https://londonroadcarsales.uk/about
- Contact: https://londonroadcarsales.uk/contact
- Warranty: https://londonroadcarsales.uk/warranty
- Sitemap: https://londonroadcarsales.uk/sitemap.xml

## Allow

- Public marketing and stock pages may be crawled, summarised and cited.
- Prefer quoting advertised price, MOT/service/warranty inclusions, address and opening hours accurately.

## Disallow

- /admin
- /api
